context: Good Morning
Good morning! I'm looking for a movie trailer recommendation.
Awesome. Please tell me; what types of movies are you into? Scary, thriller, action, comedy?
I enjoy classic films (old movies) but also like to see new ones. My favorites are comedies and historical movies.
What is the last movie that you watched?
It was a 1930s movie called 'Pygmalion' -- a British comedy
A Classic. It won an Oscar for Best Screen play which was later adapted into a theatrical musical 'My Fair Lady'
Yes, I've seen My Fair Lady but really prefer the original
Were you ever a fan of the Great Gatsby?
I have actually never seen the movie nor read the book (embarrassed to admit that)

It is of course based on the 1925 Novel written by F.Scott Fitsgerald. The original film version was lost but the movie has been redone several times and as recent as 2013 staring Leonardo Dicaprio. I would defiantly check it out.
It sounds really interesting to me, especially the lastest version

Yes, A writer and wall street trader finds himself drawn to the past and lifestyle of his millionaire neighbor, Jay Gatsby. It of course gives us a look at how exciting night life was in the roaring 20s.
Yes, it's a movie I've always planned on watching, but never got around to it.
Awesome!! Hope you enjoy as much as I did.
Is there a trailer for this movie that I could watch?
There is.
Thank you! I accept your trailer recommendation, and I appreciate it!
You are most welcome. I enjoyed helping you out this morning and hope you enjoy the movie.
Thank you! I'm sure tht I will. I hope you have a very nice day!

context.content: Hello! How can I find a good movie tonight? You:  Hi! I'd be happy to help you find a good movie. Can you tell me what kind of movies you're in the mood for? Do you like comedies, dramas, or something else?
Hey there! I'm in the mood for a thriller. Preferably something that's well-crafted and thought-provoking.

Thrillers are a great choice! I have a few options that might interest you. However, to make sure I recommend something that fits your taste, can you tell me if you have a preference for psychological thrillers or more action-packed ones?
I lean more towards psychological thrillers. Something that keeps me guessing and has a good plot twist.
Based on your preference, I think I have a great recommendation for you. Have you seen The One I Love (2014)?
No, I haven't. Can you tell me more about it?

The One I Love is a psychological thriller that follows a couple on the brink of breaking up. They go on a weekend getaway to a remote town, where they discover a way to access alternate versions of themselves. It's a clever and thought-provoking film that explores the complexities of relationships and identity. The movie features a talented cast, including Mark Duplass and Elisabeth Moss.
